title: How to Use Field Agent With Your ShotSpotter Data
summary: Ask a question in plain language and get a ShotSpotter map, chart, or briefing back. See how agencies use Field Agent and how to start today.
body_markdown:
You do not install anything on a server or change how ShotSpotter alerts reach your officers.


**1. Sign in**


Users can open Field Agent in a web browser on their desktops, laptops, or mobile data computers (MDCs) in their patrol cars. You can also download the Field Agent app from the Apple App Store or Google Play on a mobile device.


**2. Ask your first question**


Start with something you would normally ask an analyst. "Show me the last 5 days of gunfire" is a good first prompt. You will see how it responds before you build anything more complex. You can type or use voice-to-text, making the Field Agent app easy to use on a mobile device.


**3. Field Agent retrieves and analyzes the data**


Pulling from ShotSpotter data and any additional information like CAD calls or RMS reports that you’ve uploaded, Field Agent analyzes the data and provides some additional thoughts to consider — the same as other conversational AI platforms do — and waits for you to add more data to analyze or for final output instructions.


**4. Generate reports**


Field Agent can export the analysis in multiple formats, including CSV files, GeoJSON, or shapefile map layers. Tell Field Agent how you want the data displayed on a map, set up in .csv format with specified column order, or create a presentation-ready PDF or map image.
